title: Vesti la giubba (Pagliacci, Leoncavallo) — Enrico Caruso, Victor 1904
source: Library of Congress National Jukebox stream (Victor 930)
license: US: sound recording published before 1926, PD under the Music Modernization Act (100 years from publication); compositions are PD too. Korea: performers and composers died long ago (Sousa 1932, Caruso 1921, Leoncavallo 1919, Cohan 1942); a pre-1987 foreign performance is protected for the performer's life + 30 years at most, so these are PD.
notes: Acoustic 78rpm recording, so expect surface noise. Use it as is for vintage feel.
